name: labelixa-zpl
description: Preview Zebra ZPL labels and lint them while you type — the label under your cursor, rendered. No printer required.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace nothing is sent to the API: a file you have only opened to read is not shipped to a network service.

commands.title: Labelixa: Preview the label under the cursor

labelixa.apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated: the API key is now kept in the editor's secret store. Run **Labelixa: Set the API key** instead. A value left here is moved to the secret store once and then cleared.
labelixa.apiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated. Use the command **Labelixa: Set the API key**; the key is stored as a secret, never in a settings file.

labelixa.baseUrl.description: API base URL. Change this only for a self-hosted (on-premise) Labelixa.

labelixa.dpmm.description: Printer resolution in dots per mm (8 dpmm = 203 dpi).

labelixa.lintOnSave.markdownDescription: Lint on save. Linting does **not** consume label quota — only the shared rate limit. Rendering a preview does consume quota, and is never automatic.

labelixa.lintWhileTyping.markdownDescription: Lint while typing, 700 ms after you stop. Linting does **not** consume label quota — only the shared rate limit. Turn this off on a slow connection or when you share the anonymous rate limit with others.
